fact: Tech Africa News reports that the 2026 MoMo Fintech Lab, launched 12 August 2026 by Mobile Money Fintech Limited with Hubtel as technology partner, is a three-month programme giving fintech innovators hackathons, mentorship and incubation support before a national Demo Day.
A Graphic Online opinion column says the 2026 budget gives GH¢70 million to Digital Youth Hubs.
